## Web repair delivery — READY FOR CLIENT VALIDATION

Maintainer-authorized post-integration repair on one branch; no main/history rewriting or Actions executor.

| Identity | Exact SHA |
|---|---|
| Baseline main | `0289a5ee8d702450fb3f3bc73c89f30a11664bdb` |
| Baseline tree (= accepted RLS E3 tree) | `bb1aa513fe9a67a6cbec0775a6570fae6e50f877` |
| Validated source | `ac6d846a1b0c22d0f284c9ebffd976dc59698a99` |
| Validated source tree | `0f8a6cb91b40016a32a06f15b72d255219cb4de5` |
| Delivery head | `fb1d8fb989e5e31d75cd6f311c0e5e663437262d` |
| Delivery tree | `cb1a9aa31a2fadb8a434493b75c7a244d38d029b` |

Delivery head adds only three producer execution/result documents to the validated source. It does not change Runtime, tests or validators.

## Repairs and reassessment

- Status: validate exact REQ references before Store access; explicit auto references never fall back to a successful empty overview. Preserve the original unbound no-Store/not_started behavior.
- Status: stop echoing raw exceptions or debug request prose; emit one JSON document for JSON meta; align selection state and show all RLS target candidates without choosing one.
- Add a 51-entry Status build/review source lock, fourteen unique original STS-E01..STS-E14 primary tests, explicit coverage guard, and twelve-command installed-copy check. Original Status contract bytes are retained because accepted VFY locks them.
- Replace stale global Handoff and plugin-wide extrapolation of historical CTX Codex success with an eight-Skill/five-surface ledger. All forty current native cells are NOT_RUN; historical reports remain intact.
- Add native receipt binding guards and Markdown/JSON consistency validation. Synthetic guard tests never certify native behavior.
- Clarify optional development eval placement rather than manufacturing empty directories. Do not rewrite historical CTX Eval Plans. Working/distribution repository difference remains an explicit unconfirmed maintainer decision, not an automatic URL migration.

## Actually executed on exact validated source

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| Unified portable profile | 10/10 process steps PASS, clean source before/after |
| Eight Skill Interfaces and all source locks | PASS; Status lock 51 entries |
| Status fixed Eval | 14/14 PASS |
| Status coverage guard | 4/4 PASS |
| RLS fixed Eval | 87/87 PASS |
| Ordinary complete repository regression | 1104/1104 PASS; zero failure/error/skip/expectedFailure/unexpectedSuccess |
| New test methods | 40 executed: 36 inside repository suite + 4 separate coverage guards |
| Status installed-copy | 12 commands PASS; no docs/tests/tools/sibling Skills |
| VFY and RLS installed-copy | Both PASS on exact validated source |
| Independent result audit | 20 stdout/stderr byte bindings; exact unique test IDs and current source collection match |

`tests/evals/` is not traversed by ordinary unittest discovery; the new coverage guard is therefore an explicit profile step. Do not call the repository result 1108 or double-count its subsets. Original failure/retry records are retained, including local missing-parent-tree reconstruction, rejected temporary contract drift and the corrected count estimate. No tests or Expected values were weakened.

## Remaining limits — not declared PASS

- Strict VFY command 80/80 on a working OS sandbox: NOT_RUN in Web (no bwrap/sandbox-exec installed).
- Native installation/discovery/invocation/behavior: NOT_RUN; Python installed-copy tests do not replace it.
- Independent Web conformance acceptance: REQUIRED.
- Distribution target (ousui working repo vs goedgecloud metadata): maintainer decision; metadata unchanged.

The raw receipt/log/source/bundle attachment is delivered in the chat; compact exact-source hashes and Status results are persisted in this branch. The compact checkpoint is not a substitute for full raw-log review.

## Handoff

Read `docs/plugin-development/work-items/post-integration-conformance/CLIENT-GOAL.md` and use it as the complete Goal. Work only on this branch. Run strict post-integration verification, then adapt only one actually available Client/surface at a time. Do not rebuild RLS S4/E4 or rerun historical development Goals. Preserve other native cells as NOT_RUN and do not self-sign ACCEPTED.

Producer record: `docs/plugin-development/work-items/post-integration-conformance/WEB-VALIDATION.json`.
Independent review: `docs/plugin-development/work-items/post-integration-conformance/WEB-REVIEW.md`.

```text
WEB_CONFORMANCE_REPAIR = READY_FOR_CLIENT_VALIDATION
MAIN_MODIFIED = NO
SEVEN_PHASE_RUNTIMES_MODIFIED = NO
SHARED_PACKAGES_MODIFIED = NO
HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_MODIFIED = NO
WORKFLOWS_MODIFIED = NO
REAL_TARGET_EFFECTS = 0
WEB_CONFORMANCE_REVIEW = REQUIRED
PR_MERGED = NO
```

Keep Draft. No original phase Evidence, v1.1 Spec, shared Package, Workflow or production target is changed; no native compatibility or independent acceptance is self-certified.
